# Zephyr Kconfig fragment for TLS‑secured TCP networking with certificate authentication
# Target board: native_sim

# Enable the networking stack and BSD socket API
CONFIG_NETWORKING=y
CONFIG_NET_IPV4=y
CONFIG_NET_IPV6=y
CONFIG_NET_SOCKETS=y
CONFIG_NET_SOCKETS_POSIX=y

# Enable TLS support and TLS‑enabled sockets
CONFIG_TLS=y
CONFIG_TLS_SOCKET=y

# Enable TLS credential management (for loading certificates/keys)
CONFIG_TLS_CREDENTIALS=y
CONFIG_TLS_CREDENTIAL_FILES=y

# Use the built‑in MbedTLS backend
CONFIG_MBEDTLS=y
CONFIG_MBEDTLS_BUILTIN=y
CONFIG_MBEDTLS_EXTERNAL=n

# Disable any other TLS back‑ends to avoid conflicts
CONFIG_OPENSSL=n
CONFIG_TINYCRYPT=n
CONFIG_WOLFSSL=n
CONFIG_TLS_CIPHER_SUITE_MAX_LENGTH=0   # optional: ensure default limits are applied
